character: A huge orc man, about thirty, heavily muscled, green-grey skin crossed with old scars. Tusks ringed with iron. A furious roar, teeth bared.
wardrobe: A red headscarf, a leather sailor's jerkin open at the chest, bare arms, a long-bladed polearm.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing braced on a ship's deck, polearm held across his body.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Leaping over a ship's rail with his polearm swinging, sailors scattering from the blade.
